The best vet ever. 🤍 …

Every time I come to see you, Doctor, I absolutely have to leave a review.
When Dr. Angela speaks, I'm enchanted.

Dr. Valente is a highly experienced and knowledgeable professional with a boundless passion for her work and a deep love for animals, whom she treats as if they were her own children. This is a true added value that her dog and cat patients appreciate and show genuine gratitude.
Dr. Valenti is a knowledgeable and competent veterinarian. She puts great dedication, care, and attention into her work, as well as a great deal of love.
Professionalism is the cornerstone of this practice. Besides being a great professional, Dr. Valenti has a big heart.
